items.title: Joe Watkins Interview, 1961-01-20
items.q: And that's practically where I got that 4-4 beat from. From Zooty? From Zooty.

ctx.x: How would Baby be playing in the early days in New Orleans? Baby Dodds? Yeah, the same stuff that he was doing, say, on the punk records? Well, he never did change.

He never changed, right? Not to my estimation, no. Was he reading music in them days? I never seen no sheet music in front of him. No. And how about, say, Zooty? Because you see, you take the drummers in them days, they never did worry about reading music.
